verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in agent (`local-ai chat`) that operates via natural language, reading files and running shell commands behind an approval gate, backed by OpenAI-compatible function calling and MCP tool integration for broader agentic actions. This is a first-party, well-documented natural-language command interface, not just an API wrapper.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the NL command execution, and detail on the breadth/reliability of commands it can safely interpret and run.
